{{Conjecture|legends}}
'''Dorin gas''' was a [[Gas/Legends|gas]] found only in the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]]. It was essential for the lives of [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] in the same way that [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] was essential for the lives of the majority of [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Without it, Kel Dor would become blind and [[Death/Legends|die]]. [[Antiox breath mask/Legends|Antiox breath masks]] provided Dorin gas to Kel Dor traveling off-world.
